summary: The two remaining screens come from the unported music.c:calm_nymphs helper on the wooden-harp success path. At step 85, do_improvisation has already passed the harp gate and emitted the melody; it calls calm_nymphs before exercise(A_DEX). C changes the nearby mobile nymph to peaceful and clears sleep, avenge, and wait-strategy state, then its visible-nymph pline reaches a More boundary. Space at step 86 dismisses that boundary, shows the nymph response, and only then lets the helper return so exercise consumes rn2(19)=6. JS currently records note_unported("music.c calm_nymphs") and skips both those state changes and the awaited message. The existing TTY message path owns the pager behavior; this case does not identify a separate topl.c:more defect. The source-traced task is a file-port of the whole calm_nymphs function in music.c, wired at the existing wooden-harp call site in js/music.js.

source.branch: do_improvisation(WOODEN_HARP) reaches do_spec=true after rn2(ACURR(A_DEX)) + u.ulevel > 25, then calls calm_nymphs(u.ulevel * 3) before exercising Dexterity. For each non-dead monster, calm_nymphs selects S_NYMPH monsters that can move and whose mdistu is below that distance; it clears sleeping, makes them peaceful, clears avenge and STRAT_WAITMASK, and prints the response only when canseemon is true. The recorded level-30 case passes the gate with rn2(18)=12 and invokes the helper with distance 90.
callers: C apply.c:doapply (4373-4383) routes WOODEN_HARP to music.c:do_play_instrument; JS cmd.js rhack (5145-5146) routes doapply through runApplyCommand to apply.js:doapply, whose instrument arm (5008-5019) calls music.js:do_play_instrument.

C music.c:do_play_instrument (776-784) asks Improvise? and, for a non-n key, calls music.c:do_improvisation while consuming its ECMD_TIME/ECMD_OK return. JS music.js:do_play_instrument (327-334) mirrors this and consumes the do_improvisation result.

C music.c:do_improvisation wooden-harp arm (672-686) calls calm_nymphs when do_spec is true, before exercise(A_DEX, TRUE). JS music.js:do_improvisation (271-279) has the same gate and message order, but the call site currently invokes note_unported("music.c calm_nymphs") instead of the helper.
dependencies: The helper consumes hack.h:mdistu(mon), a distance-squared return; the JS music module already imports dist2 from hacklib.js, which can represent the macro as dist2(mon.mx, mon.my, state.u.ux, state.u.uy). It also filters DEADMONSTER, S_NYMPH, and mcanmove and mutates msleeping, mpeaceful, mavenge, and mstrategy on the selected monster.

canseemon(mon) gates the visible response and Monnam(mon) supplies its name; js/music.js already imports canseemon from vision.js and Monnam from do_name.js. Their returned values are consumed by the source branch.

C pline is void but its awaited TTY effect may block on More. The JS caller must await the response message before returning to do_improvisation, preserving the source order before exercise(A_DEX). do_play_instrument separately consumes the existing do_improvisation command-time result; preserve that caller contract.
